posts.zh:
dsh-session-search-pro 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-77fe81d19888452ed502.html
posts.en:
dsh-session-search-pro is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-77fe81d19888452ed502.html
